description.value: King Pacific Lodge is a luxury floating sport fishing resort moored at Milbanke Sound on BC's remote Central Coast, reachable only by floatplane or boat. Family-owned and operated by George and Lisa Cuthbert for over 25 years, it offers guided Chinook and Coho salmon fishing packages alongside spa facilities (hot tub, steam room, sauna), fine dining, and multiple lounge areas. Guests have included Kevin Costner and other celebrities, and the lodge prides itself on a highly personalized, all-inclusive wilderness experience.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully accessible and confirms King Pacific Lodge is an active, family-owned floating luxury sport fishing resort at Milbanke Sound on BC's remote Central Coast, with 2026 season packages and a May 2026 blog post confirming current operations. The lodge is accessible only by floatplane or boat — no road access exists — so no cycling-specific amenities are mentioned anywhere on the site, leaving all bike-related criteria as null. The website contact address (4850 Cowley Crescent, Richmond, BC) is explicitly a sales office, not the physical lodge location, which is a floating structure at Milbanke Sound matching the OSM coordinates.
concerns: Lodge is a floating structure at Milbanke Sound accessible only by floatplane or boat — no road or cycling access to the physical location.
The address on the website (4850 Cowley Crescent, Richmond, BC V7B 1C1) is a sales/admin office, not the physical lodge location; OSM coordinates correctly place the lodge at Milbanke Sound.
OSM record has no address or phone tags; phone and address sourced from website only.
Social media activity appears to have stalled around 2019 on X/Twitter, though the website and blog are current through May 2026.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, actively operating business with confirmed 2026 season. Lack of cycling amenities is not grounds for exclusion.
